title: Conceptual Hint
content: Modern applications rely on lockfiles (such as package-lock.json or poetry.lock) to freeze dependency trees. Attackers frequently sneak in malicious code via compromised transitive dependencies.

title: Directional Hint
content: Look at the web interface or make a GET request to find where the automated CI/CD dependency audit report is published.

title: Technical Hint
content: Access `/packages/audit/package_lock_audit.json` and look through the `dependencies` object for any non-standard packages from untrusted authors.

title: Solution Clue
content: Examine the `apex-internal-telemetry` package metadata inside the audit report. The `exfiltrated_pipeline_token` contains the flag in standard `ZITERA{...}` format.
